description: Off-by-one error: using this.length instead of input.length() for substring end bound, which could cause issues if length was incorrectly initialized or mutable.
Off-by-one boundary bug: setting pos to length - 1 instead of length when consuming to end.
Wrong variable usage: using pos as the beginning index of substring instead of input.length(), resulting in an empty or incorrect substring when consuming to end.
Missing state update: failing to update `pos` to the end of the input string during `consumeToEnd()`.
Wrong argument swapped or offset: substring starts at pos + 1 instead of pos, skipping the current character.
